We report the BARTScore and Rouge-L between generated and reference answers as metrics for adequacy of generated answers. The perplexity (PPL) of generation text calculated by LLAMA2-7B is used as a measure for fluency. We also measure quoting with QUIP‑Score.

To our main interest, we measure quoting with QUIP-Score using the Wikipedia subset of the Pile dataset as the grounding corpus C. We report the BARTScore and Rouge-L between generated and reference answers as metrics for adequacy of generated answers. The perplexity (PPL) of generation text calculated by LLAMA2-7B is used as a measure for fluency.
